description: Website conversion events posted to the X Ads measurement conversions endpoint.

params.name: pixel_id
params.description: It is the X Pixel ID, and it travels in the path.
params.fix_hint: Put the Pixel ID in the path as `/12/measurement/conversions/{pixel_id}`.

params.name: conversion_time
params.description: X documents the conversion time as an ISO 8601 timestamp.
params.fix_hint: Send an ISO 8601 timestamp, such as `2022-02-18T01:14:00.603Z`.

params.name: event_id
params.description: It is the conversion event UUID from Ads Manager, not a per-hit dedup key.
params.fix_hint: Send the conversion event ID from Ads Manager as `event_id`. Use `conversion_id` for dedup.

params.name: conversion_id
params.description: It is the per-event id used to deduplicate the pixel and the conversion API.
params.fix_hint: Send the same `conversion_id` the website tag fired.

params.name: identifiers[].twclid
params.description: X click identifier from the landing URL. One of the identifiers X requires, along with hashed email or hashed phone.
params.fix_hint: Send the `twclid` query parameter captured from the click.

params.name: identifiers[].hashed_email
params.description: Email must be trimmed, lowercased, and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Trim and lowercase the address, hash it with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: identifiers[].hashed_phone_number
params.description: Phone must be normalized to E.164 and SHA-256 hashed before it is sent.
params.fix_hint: Normalize to E.164, hash with SHA-256, and send the hex digest.

params.name: identifiers[].ip_address
params.description: It is the visitor IP address, sent unhashed. X documents that IP or user agent must be paired with a second identifier.
params.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address, and also send `twclid`, `hashed_email`, or `hashed_phone_number`.

params.name: identifiers[].user_agent
params.description: It is the visitor user agent, sent unhashed.
params.fix_hint: Send the browser's user agent string, not a digest.

params.name: price_currency
params.description: It is an ISO 4217 currency code.
params.fix_hint: Use the three-letter code, such as `USD`.

rules.message: The conversion carries none of the identifiers X requires. Send `twclid`, `hashed_email`, or `hashed_phone_number`. IP and user agent are not enough on their own.
rules.fix_hint: Add a `twclid`, a SHA-256 hashed email, or a SHA-256 hashed phone number.

rules.message: A field carries what looks like a raw email address. X requires email as `hashed_email`, SHA-256 hashed on the client side.
rules.fix_hint: Trim the address, lowercase it, hash it with SHA-256, and send it as `hashed_email`.

rules.message: This field looks like a SHA-256 digest, but X documents `ip_address` and `user_agent` as unhashed.
rules.fix_hint: Send the raw IP address or user agent. Hashing it makes the event unmatchable.
